acceptance.title: Acceptance of these terms
body: By creating an account or using OuWealth Community ("OuWealth", "we"), you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the platform.

service.title: The service
body: OuWealth is software for Saving Schemes: members, contributions, loans, fines, social fund, investments, payouts and reports. We are a software provider. We are not a bank, a lender or a financial adviser.

accounts.title: Accounts and responsibilities
body: Keep your sign-in details private and give accurate information. Scheme presidents and officers are responsible for the records they enter and the approvals they give, and for using roles correctly.

data.title: Scheme data
body: Your scheme owns its records. You must have the right to enter the information of your members. We handle personal information as described in the Privacy and personal data section below.

privacy.title: Privacy and personal data
body: We process personal information only to run OuWealth. In general, this means:
items: Account details: name, username, email and phone number.
Member records: national ID and address where your scheme records them, membership date and shares.
Financial records of the scheme: contributions, loans, fines, social fund, investments, payouts and transactions.
Files you upload, such as proof of payment, and sign-in and audit records.
after: We use it to provide and secure the service, show records to the people your scheme authorizes, send notifications about your scheme, manage subscriptions and give support.
Access depends on role: each member sees what their role allows, and authorized officers see the records of their own Saving Scheme only. We do not sell personal information.

You may request access, correction, restriction or deletion of your personal information, object to certain processing, and exercise other rights available under applicable law. Some financial and audit records may have to be kept.

subscription.title: Subscription
body: New schemes may start with a free trial, then continue on a monthly or annual subscription at the prices shown on our website. When a subscription ends, actions that record or change financial data may be limited until it is renewed. Reading records and downloading reports stays available.

use.title: Acceptable use
body: Do not use the platform for unlawful activity, share your account, upload harmful files, or try to disrupt or break into the service.

liability.title: Availability and liability
body: We work to keep the platform available and accurate, but we cannot promise it will never be interrupted. To the extent the law allows, OuWealth is not responsible for indirect losses or for decisions made from records entered by scheme members.

suspension.title: Suspension
body: We may suspend an account that breaks these terms or puts the platform or other users at risk.

changes.title: Changes and governing law
body: We may update these terms and will publish the new version here with a new effective date. Continuing to use OuWealth means you accept the update. These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Rwanda.

duties.SUPER_ADMIN: Platform owner: not a member of any Saving Scheme. Create groups, appoint Presidents, see every Saving Scheme, and take full control when officers need help.
duties.MEMBER: Save each month, request loans, and view your own fines, social fund, and share-out.

duties.COOPERATIVE_ADMIN: Chair the group, settle disputes, suspend members, approve rule changes, and co-sign money leaving the fund.

summary.explain: Expected contributions are expectations, never cash. Rotating money is shown apart from retained capital, and what recipients are still owed is a liability, not member capital.
summary.rotatingCollectedHint: Verified; the base of recipient entitlements
summary.reconciliationHint: Recorded without verification; not owed or payable yet
summary.totalLiabilitiesHint: Owed on verified money plus rotating money not yet reconciled
summary.unclassifiedHint: Paid before the model was recorded; neither retained nor owed until resolved
summary.unresolvedRotatingHint: Held for recipients; not payable and not member capital until attributed

historicalTransactions.title: Historical transactions
historicalTransactions.description: Import the dated history of an existing Saving Scheme across several years.
historicalTransactions.intro: A guided import in four steps: download the template, fill the two worksheets, validate (nothing is posted), then a different officer approves it.

rules.sheets: The workbook has exactly two worksheets: Members and Configuration, and Historical Transactions.
rules.noInvention: Nothing is invented: unsupported event types, unknown members and bad dates are rejected row by row.
rules.loans: Loans and member payouts cannot be imported as history: they need schedules, breakdowns and recipients that a dated list does not hold. Use the opening-balance loan migration for loans.
rules.overlap: History must end before the first live record of the scheme, so nothing is counted twice.
rules.unresolved: Imported contributions are never payout-eligible and never assigned to a recipient: their original rotation period is unresolved.
rules.final: Posting is final. Records already posted are never edited or deleted.

issue.UNSUPPORTED_ROW_TYPE: This event type cannot be imported. Supported: CONTRIBUTION, FINE_PAYMENT, OTHER_INCOME, GENERAL_EXPENSE. Loans and member payouts are not importable as history; use the opening-balance loan migration for loans.
issue.UNSUPPORTED_SETTING: Unknown setting. Supported: OPENING_BALANCE, DECLARED_CLOSING_BALANCE, HISTORY_END_DATE, CURRENCY, OPERATING_MODEL.
issue.MISSING_SETTING: A required setting is missing, so the history cannot be reconciled.
issue.USERNAME_REQUIRED: A member row needs a username.
issue.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: This username is not a member of this Saving Scheme. Members are never created by this import.
issue.DUPLICATE_IN_FILE: This appears more than once in the file.
issue.INVALID_SHARE_COUNT: Share Count must be a whole number of zero or more.
issue.INVALID_AMOUNT: The amount is not valid: it must be positive with at most four decimals.
issue.INVALID_DATE: The date is not a real date (yyyy-mm-dd).
issue.DATE_IN_FUTURE: The date is in the future.
issue.DATE_AFTER_HISTORY_END: The date is after the history end date.
issue.DATE_OVERLAPS_LIVE_RECORDS: The date is on or after the first live record of the scheme. History must end before live records begin, or it would be counted twice.
issue.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The currency differs from the scheme currency.
issue.OPERATING_MODEL_MISMATCH: The operating model differs from the scheme.
issue.DUPLICATE_SETTING: This setting is given more than once.
issue.MEMBER_REQUIRED: This event type needs a member.
issue.REFERENCE_REQUIRED: The original reference is required for this event type.
issue.LOAN_REFERENCE_REQUIRED: Loan rows need a Loan Reference that groups the loan.
issue.LOAN_REFERENCE_NOT_APPLICABLE: Only loan rows carry a Loan Reference.
issue.PERIOD_NOT_APPLICABLE: Only contribution rows carry a period.
issue.MODEL_NOT_APPLICABLE: Only contribution rows carry an operating model.
issue.INVALID_PERIOD: The contribution period is not valid.
issue.INVALID_MODEL: Use ACCUMULATING, ROTATING or HYBRID, or leave it blank when unknown.
issue.DUPLICATE_EXISTING_CONTRIBUTION: This member already has a contribution for this period. Imports never merge into or replace existing records.
issue.LOAN_DISBURSEMENT_MISSING: This loan has no disbursement row in the file.
issue.LOAN_DISBURSED_TWICE: A loan reference needs exactly one disbursement row.
issue.LOAN_MEMBER_MISMATCH: Every row of a loan must name the borrower of its disbursement.
issue.REPAYMENT_BEFORE_DISBURSEMENT: A repayment cannot be dated before the loan was disbursed.
issue.LOAN_OVERPAID: Principal repayments exceed the amount disbursed.
issue.LOAN_NOT_CLOSED: This loan still has principal outstanding at the end of the history. Loans that are still open belong in the opening-balance loan migration, not here.
issue.DUPLICATE_PREVIOUSLY_IMPORTED: This exact event was already imported in an earlier batch.
issue.NO_TRANSACTIONS: The transactions sheet has no rows.

modelReport.invalidRange: The start date must not be after the end date.
modelReport.unresolved: Some collections are not classified ({{unclassified}}) or are known to be rotating with an unresolved period ({{rotating}}). They are shown apart and are never member capital or payable to a recipient.
modelReport.distributionUnavailable: Distribution of earnings is unavailable until the scheme approves a distribution policy. No dividend or percentage is calculated here.
modelReport.indicativeOnly: Proportional to capital. An indication only: the attribution of earnings is not an approved policy.

migrationReview.notice: This Saving Scheme brought its history in more than one way before the safeguard existed. Historical imports are paused until the President or Vice President resolves the review. Everything else works as usual.
migrationReview.noticeAuthority: This Saving Scheme brought its history in more than one way before the safeguard existed. Historical imports are paused until you resolve the review.
migrationReview.resolveExplain: Say which strategy is authoritative and how the scheme was reconciled. This does not change any figures: correct any duplicated history first, through the normal correction workflows. The decision is recorded.

migrationReview.platformExplain: These Saving Schemes accept no further historical import until their fund authority resolves the review.

positions.title: Members' positions
positions.help: Capital grows by what each member keeps in the scheme; income is shared equally per share; the rotation column is what the scheme owes the member (positive) or the interest-free advance the member is repaying (negative).
positions.reconciliation: Members' capital, income and rotation add up to {{expected}} RWF; cash, loans out and investments are {{actual}} RWF (difference {{difference}}). Income to share: {{income}} RWF, {{perShare}} per share.
positions.advanceNote: You received {{amount}} RWF ahead of contributing it. It is not a loan and has no interest: your remaining monthly contributions repay it.
positions.owedNote: The scheme still owes you {{amount}} RWF of rotation: it is paid on your turn.

openingWorkbook.title: Rotation and opening positions
openingWorkbook.help: The third migration workbook, for a scheme that was already running. Import it after the members & share-capital workbook and the loans workbook.
openingWorkbook.step1: Scheme sheet: the running cycle (first month, months, payout per share, rotated amount per share, how shares are paid), the rotation money in the bank at the cutover, and income earned before the cutover not yet shared. Leave the cycle rows empty for an accumulating scheme.
openingWorkbook.step2: Turns sheet: one row per member and month: shares paid in that month and what was already received before the cutover.
openingWorkbook.step3: Members sheet: rotated money each member paid before the cutover, and any amount the scheme owes the member.
openingWorkbook.result: {{members}} members updated; owed to members {{owed}} RWF; income to share {{income}} RWF.
openingWorkbook.rotationResult: Rotation: paid in {{paid}}, paid out {{received}}, so {{expected}} RWF should be in the bank (difference {{difference}}).
